children.name: Article Eyebrow
children.text: PLATFORM

children.name: Article Title
children.text: Standalone panel

children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Run the dashboard and API on a host without Kubernetes, then register remote game clusters and manage their credentials.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Set GAMEPLANE_REMOTE_ALLOWED_CIDRS before registering clusters, or registration can reach any private address the panel host can reach.

children.name: Section Title 1
children.text: Run with Docker Compose

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Two services, no Kubernetes on the host; the API stays on the Compose network.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Set GAMEPLANE_REMOTE_ALLOWED_CIDRS to your API and gateway networks.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Run exactly one gameplane-api container; never scale it.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Bootstrap the first admin against the same database volume.

children.name: Section Title 2
children.text: Keep the database and key apart

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Settings and credentials are encrypted with the panel key; recovery needs both halves.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Back up the database and WAL files after stopping services.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Back up the panel key separately, with restricted access.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Provision the key outside database storage when you can.

children.name: Section Title 3
children.text: Register remote clusters

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Each target runs its own operator. The panel stores registrations in SQL, with no Cluster resource.

children.name: Quick Reference Label
children.text: STANDALONE

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Compose: set GAMEPLANE_REMOTE_ALLOWED_CIDRS, run one API

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Back up the database and panel key separately

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Register clusters with POST /clusters; grant per cluster

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Restore the database and key together; a new key cannot decrypt existing credentials.

children.name: Section Title 1
children.text: Rotate kubeconfigs and upgrade

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Rotate with PUT, then verify the cluster before revoking the old credential.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Use PUT /clusters/NAME/kubeconfig; the registration keeps its identity.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Verify required operations before revoking the old credential.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Stop services and back up before upgrading; match remote operator versions.
